title: Egyptian symbols in a Freemasonic temple in DC

tellings.quote: I've been inside of this like Freemasonic temple in DC

plain: A temple of the Freemasons, the old fraternal society, in Washington DC is said to be filled with Egyptian symbols. Michels tells this himself from his own visit, saying "I've been inside of this like Freemasonic temple in DC," and mentions a figure the transcript renders as "Charles law font" without saying more about him. He raises it as a hint that old esoteric traditions sit close to the heart of American power.
